hypothesis: The exact v51 SP500/SPCX live-v3 route may retain an attributable after-cost edge when its backend and source-native observer decisions remain identical and complete lifecycles occur on both configured sides.
decision: Continue the exact v51 SP500/SPCX route unchanged. The expanded prospective window proves 76/76 source-native observer decisions match the executable backend with zero mismatches. Both post-start eligible decisions were shorts and both became live entries; no post-start long signal exists yet, so the configured long side remains economically untested.

findings.interpretation: The two independent live processes agree on every current-run decision, and neither eligible signal was lost between the source-native observer and backend entry path. This closes the current decision-transport question but does not establish profitability or long-side behavior. Observer long signals recorded before the v51 run are not substituted for attributable v51 live lifecycles.

limitations: Decision parity does not prove execution profitability or fill quality.
Both eligible current-run signals were short, so long-side execution and exit behavior remain unobserved.
SPCX is a one-trade winner and is entirely largest-winner dependent.
SP500 remains open and its marked result is provisional.
The observer and backend can share the same upstream public-data defect.
Archive and live-v3 source identities remain non-interchangeable.
falsifier: Reject current-run decision transport parity if any later common completed boundary differs, any eligible observer signal lacks an attributable backend action or explicit position/router non-action, source coverage becomes incomplete, or run/profile/provider identity changes. Update economic confidence only with resolved, attributable long and short lifecycles after exact fees, funding, slippage, latency, stop behavior, exit attribution, and largest-winner sensitivity.

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep the exact v51 index route and 100/40/80 completed-bar profit-lock unchanged while collecting the first attributable long lifecycle and resolving the open SP500 short.
recommendation.Why now: Decision transport is now validated through both eligible current-run onsets; the remaining uncertainty is economics and side coverage rather than missing or mismatched signals.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: Immutable 76-decision backend-observer parity, exact SPCX short lifecycle and corrected replay, protected open SP500 short, current v51 config identity, and source-quality status.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: No eligible long onset has occurred since v51 started, while the two short onsets both routed and entered. SPCX produced one profitable resolved exit and SP500 is still right-censored.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Source-native completed-15m fresh breakout-pressure onsets with causal top-ten pressure age at or below 15 seconds.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Retune entry thresholds for more long signals, pool pre-v51 observer longs, infer edge from one SPCX winner, or preserve the frozen contract and collect attributable both-side evidence.
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserves a technically aligned entry/exit path while obtaining unbiased side-separated evidence before any retune.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: Sparse and one-sided outcomes, shared upstream data defects, open-position right censoring, completed-bar exit gap risk, execution drag, and false confidence from one winner.
recommendation.Validation completed: Current-run identity binding, 76/76 decision parity, two eligible-short route translations, SPCX protection/exit/fees/funding/flat reconciliation, and SP500 entry/protection attribution.
recommendation.Validation still required: At least one resolved attributable long lifecycle per index symbol where feasible, resolution of the open SP500 short, additional short outcomes, actual-minus-stress residuals, largest-winner sensitivity, and shared-portfolio interaction evidence.
recommendation.Success metrics: No unexplained eligible-without-action event; complete protection and flat/order reconciliation; positive side-separated after-cost economics; positive net excluding the largest winner when sample size permits; and bounded execution residuals versus stress.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: Any decision mismatch, unprotected exposure, orphan order, stale/conflicting attribution, repeated execution drag beyond stress, exit-branch mismatch, or a compatible predeclared sample with adverse after-cost expectancy.
recommendation.Confidence level: High confidence in current-run decision transport; low confidence in economic edge and long-side behavior.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Capture and resolve the first attributable v51 long lifecycle for SPCX, the highest-ranked unresolved route-side in the live improvement digest, while continuing to resolve the existing HYPE and SP500 shorts under their frozen exits.
